task.description: Ran the full suite for real (scripts/test_parallel.sh, N=8 partitions, blocking foreground run): combined 2796 tests, 6 properties, 6 failures (2796/2802 passed). 5 of the 6 failures are documented pre-existing flake/environmental classes structurally unrelated to this branch's diff (3x Letflow.TenantSchemaReaperTest ISS-0110 connection-contention flake in partition 1, each logging the module's own 'deferring this sweep entirely ... ISS-0110' diagnostic line; 2x Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest rust-pin tests in partition 8 failing with System.cmd("rustc", ...) :enoent because rustc/cargo are genuinely absent from this sandbox's PATH, same class as the REQ-181/REQ-177/REQ-178 runs) -- neither test file is touched by this branch's diff (git diff main...HEAD --stat confirmed). The 6th failure is a GENUINE REGRESSION from this branch: 'test C6 -- oracle-rot guard observed tables equal expected_tenant_tables/0 in both directions (Letflow.Support.TenantFixtureTest)' at test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_test.exs:382 fails with 'a manifest migration created a table the oracle does not list: ["audit_entries"]'. This branch adds priv/repo/migrations/20260830020001_create_audit_entries_tenant_scoped.exs, a tenant-scoped migration (if prefix() do ... end guard, Decision 0003-B) creating audit_entries inside every tenant schema, but test/support/tenant_fixture.ex's @expected_tenant_tables oracle list (currently 26 entries, lines ~122-150) was not updated to include "audit_entries", and test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_test.exs:305's companion count assertion (assert length(TenantFixture.expected_tenant_tables()) == 26) was not bumped to 27. This is the identical bug class to REQ-181 (webhook_subscriptions missing from the same oracle, routed back to ELIXIR-DEV and fixed there -- see test/reports/report-2026-08-29-WF02-REQ181-20260829.yaml) and REQ-176/REQ-125 both correctly followed this same convention when adding a tenant-scoped table. Reproduced standalone: mix test test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_test.exs -> same single failure, isolated from the rest of the suite.
acceptance_criteria: Add "audit_entries" to test/support/tenant_fixture.ex's @expected_tenant_tables list (keep the list's existing alphabetical ordering convention).
Bump test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_test.exs:305's count assertion from 26 to 27 (and update its surrounding comment if it names the count/table list literally).
Re-run `mix test test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_test.exs` and confirm the C6 oracle-rot guard now passes.

Re-run the full `scripts/test_parallel.sh` suite and confirm only the two documented pre-existing flake classes (ISS-0110 TenantSchemaReaperTest, rustc-absent CheckToolchainTest) remain, with zero new failures.
Do not touch lib/letflow/audit.ex's schema/logic to work around this -- the gap is purely in the test-support oracle list not tracking the new migration; no application-code change is implicated.
Route back to TEST-RUNNER (not directly to RELEASE-VALIDATOR) once fixed, per WF-02, so the full suite gets re-verified formally.

result.summary: 6 total suite failures: 5 are documented pre-existing flakes/environmental gaps unrelated to this branch's diff (ISS-0110 TenantSchemaReaperTest x3, rustc-absent CheckToolchainTest x2), 1 is a genuine regression -- test/support/tenant_fixture.ex's @expected_tenant_tables oracle and its companion count assertion were not updated for the new audit_entries tenant-scoped table this branch's migration adds. Same bug class and same fix as REQ-181's precedent.
result.next_action: ELIXIR-DEV to add the missing table to the oracle list and bump the count assertion, then route back to TEST-RUNNER for a fresh full-suite run.
